premerge.body:
Part of #273. Owner acceptance and closure remain open on that issue.

Changing a node ID repairs understood JSONata and Liquid references, typed mutation pointers and edge endpoints in one undoable edit. Known missing gate and visit identities block publication; dynamic or ambiguous reads remain warnings. Published versions and pinned runs remain unchanged.

The editor preserves collection identity, disclosure and nested focus during repairs. A valid self-reference rename also preserves the first Add, Remove or switch activation: canonical config repair happens in place, while the dialog's cosmetic notice waits through the press. Canceled gestures are not replayed. Equal unapplied JSON stays held until an author action.

## Current candidate and gates

Head `b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e`, tree `8b7cd8d131917ce74da0d8b7a684317477be22ce`, targets main `a817e5ccb4fd598ca56089b97b4ce55e9cb6f58c`. This final evidence commit changes no product, test or build input from independently tested source `09167b3ec5d0bd553981ceaa8498ddb9be4c9458`. All 63 added evidence files (1,616,991 bytes), the register and QA attributes matched staged and committed blobs.

[Current-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43651091055) and [routing](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43651091052) passed all five jobs on their first attempts. Coverage completed all 22 tasks (web 2,546 tests in 207 files; domain 459 in 29). Browser passed 479 tests with one expected live-provider skip and zero retries; Windows passed 14/14. Template-image and routing checks passed. The dependency audit's high-severity threshold passed with eight low and thirteen moderate advisories. Root completed the capped disposition after reading the full retained logs and verifying unchanged product/test/build inputs from the independently tested source.

All three formal scans are consumed. [Final Astra scan 3 and root dispositions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/474#issuecomment-6884243175) remain preserved as **CHANGES REQUIRED** on historical head `5a4fb439`. Both final findings are now corrected and independently verified: evaluated references inside computed lookup keys are visited, and the first pointer activation survives a self-reference rename. Under D-035/D-042 this is known-cause correction, root completion inspection, independent behavior QA and exact-head/current-target CI; it is not a fourth scan or fresh Astra sign-off, and no known in-scope blocker is waived.

## Verification

GPT owns domain/API architecture and implementation; Claude owns editor design and implementation. [ADR-0075](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e/docs/decisions/ADR-0075-node-id-reference-repair.md) defines the boundary.

- The final computed-key correction passed 98 focused domain tests; six identical regressions failed on old source. The UI correction passed 41 focused and 87 related tests plus no-emit typecheck, lint and formatting. The final eight activation tests produced five failures on old source and three controls. [Domain correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-final-correction-domain/README.md) · [UI correction](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-final-correction-ui/README.md)
- Independent native QA used a fresh forced build: 12 tasks, zero cache hits. Both A1 HTTP/domain groups passed on the first admitted fixture, with 26 HTTP operations, exact `422 LOOP_INVALID` refusal and immutable prior release/pin checks. The initial missing external directory stopped the launcher before process spawn and is retained.
- The first A2 Edge run passed eight cases, 41 checkpoints and 29 conditional PUTs including setup/history. It checked original-control Add/Remove/Boolean activation, actual outside-up cancellation, duplicate-ID refusal with an independent Add, Tab/Space, and four exact Undo/Redo/API/device states for each pending action. Modal notice timing is recorded separately from the pane notice behind the native dialog. Native touch-driven pointercancel and held malformed JSON remain separately labeled component evidence.
- All 68 source hashes, 17 embedded modules and 1,227 built files across 13 trees matched before and after QA. Both fixtures closed cleanly. Root read the full report and inspected three screenshots. [Final independent evidence and root inspection](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-final-independent/README.md)

The [original opposite-family dispositions](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/474#issuecomment-6882534449), original negative traces, earlier corrections and historical CI results remain in the [delivery register](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e/docs/delivery/2026-11-13-four-intents-register.md). F1/F2/U1/U2/U3 remain corrected. Count-ownership duplication and unused syntax diagnostics remain tracked as #476/#477. No owner instance/store change or real provider turn is part of this PR.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the actual merged build and observations on #273. Confirm that the repair summary and uncertainty guidance are understandable, warning navigation is predictable, and preserved editing/focus behavior feels right during ordinary authoring. Machine-checkable behavior remains the pipeline's responsibility.

**Owner-approved consolidated revision, 2026-10-18. Implementation remains held by #279.** Latest owner decisions in #278 supersede older proposals and historical comments. This approval authorizes backlog publication only; no implementation, owner-environment change, or provider run is dispatched.

Authority and complete owner decision record: #278. Current text supersedes older model proposals and historical scheduling/approval statements; comments remain historical evidence, not a competing current specification.

## Bounded change

Repair understood node-ID references

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rename updates structurally understood references atomically; known broken references block publication, dynamic uncertainty is explained and unrelated strings are unchanged.

- [ ] Repair only references whose structure is understood; do not blindly replace node-ID text inside arbitrary scripts, prompts or JSON.

## Verification

Expressions/templates/structured references supported by current contract, undo/save/reload and intentional ambiguous strings.

## Dependencies

- #281 — X-EDITOR
- #279 — implementation dispatch remains held.

## Scope limits

Only the described behavior and its necessary tests/contracts/docs.

## Delivery and closure

Approved plan; parked pending explicit dispatch. Proposed implementer: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh; independent reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh; independent QA: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh. QA scope: touched systems, including relevant positive, negative, concurrency, cancellation and restart cases. All tests use supported interfaces; retain existing coverage protections.

**Owner product acceptance required before closure.** PRs use Part of rather than auto-closing this issue until the owner has accepted the running behavior.

No implementation gate labels are applied now. After later dispatch, select the repository gate consistent with owner-review requirements; never combine aidlc-ready and human-in-the-loop.

## Source requirements

#273

## Evidence provenance (not a new test result)

The observations below describe their original assessed baseline. They are not current solution requirements; the approved scope above controls. Reproduce on the accepted target before relying on them.
